title: `AaveProtocolDataProvider.getAllReservesTokens` reverts if any reserve token lacks `symbol()`
impact: The function special-cases `MKR` and `ETH` sentinel addresses, but any other non-standard token (e.g., a token with a fallback-only `symbol`, or a proxy whose `symbol()` reverts) will cause the entire `getAllReservesTokens()` call to revert, breaking frontends and monitoring that enumerate reserves. This is a read-path DoS, not a fund loss.
